# WIDTH_SLOPE 707.5 → 708: a width-envelope lever the whole lineage left untuned

`src/point_add/mod.rs`, `configure_ecdsafail_submission_route()`:
- Added `DIALOG_GCD_WIDTH_SLOPE_X1000 = 708` (was the hard-coded default 707.5).
- Retuned the neutral Fiat-Shamir reroll to the clean island the tighter slope
  re-rolls into: `DIALOG_REROLL = 101019` (`DIALOG_POST_SUB_REROLL` unchanged at
  the inherited 503292). The reroll inserts self-cancelling X-pairs that only
  reseed the SHAKE256-derived test inputs — circuit action, Toffoli count and
  qubit count are unchanged.
